S.FORM: amyan su tau? nu-kakwa i-m-angay mang-aep su uvi?
S.PHON: amjan ʂo taoʔ nokakwa imaŋaj maŋaəp ʂo ofiʔ
S.FORM: amian so tao nokakoa imangay mangaep so ovi
S.PHON: amian ʂ[o|u] ta[o|u] n[o|u]kak[o|u]a imaŋaj maŋaəp ʂ[o|u] [o|u]fi
S.TRANSL: A long time ago, there was a person who went to get some potatoes.

S.FORM: kwan-a nu anak-ne-m tu-lavi? s-ina s-ina kwan-a
S.PHON: kwana no anaknəm tolafiʔ ʂina ʂina kwana
S.FORM: koana no anaknem tolavi sina sina koana
S.PHON: k[o|u]ana n[o|u] anaknəm t[o|u]lafi ɕina ɕina k[o|u]ana

S.TRANSL: the child said to his father,

S.FORM: yana-ni-aep nu kangkang lu kuang kwan-a
S.PHON: jananiaəp no kaŋkaŋ lo koaŋ kwana
S.FORM: yananiaep no kangkang lo koang koana
S.PHON: jananiaəp n[o|u] kaŋkaŋ l[o|u] k[o|u]aŋ k[o|u]ana
S.TRANSL: The rooster took her far away."

S.FORM: maniring s-ama-na-m uyuda nana-ni-aep nu kangkang
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ ʂamanam ojoɖa nananiaəp no kaŋkaŋ
S.FORM: maniring samanam oyoda nananiaep no kangkang
S.TRANSL: The father said, "Oh, the rooster took her!"

S.FORM: k-angay-da-rana lu tatala kalaǥen s-ina-na lu ilaud
S.PHON: kaŋajɖaɻana lo tatala kalaɰən ʂinana lo ilaoɖ
S.FORM: kangaydarana lo tatala kalahen sinana lo ilaod
S.PHON: kaŋajɖaɻana l[o|u] tatala kalaɰən ɕinana l[o|u] ila[o|u]ɖ
S.TRANSL: and they went to the boat to hunt for the mother in a foreign country.

S.FORM: y-amyan lu chia? su tau? kwan-ta
S.PHON: jamjan lo ʨiaʔ ʂo taoʔ kwanta
S.FORM: yamian lo cia so tao koanta
S.PHON: jamian l[o|u] ʨia ʂ[o|u] ta[o|u] k[o|u]anta
S.TRANSL: "Is there anyone (of our own people) here?"

S.FORM: kwan-ta nu tau? uri? lu ya-makarang a-takakal
S.PHON: kwanta no taoʔ oɻiʔ lo jamakaɻaŋ atakakal
S.FORM: koanta no tao ori lo yamakarang atakakal
S.PHON: k[o|u]anta n[o|u] ta[o|u] [o|u]ɻi l[o|u] jamakaɻaŋ atakakal

S.TRANSL: the child said, "Here you are, Mother!"
"You are not my child," said his mother.

S.FORM: kwan-a nu anak-ne-m puken a s-ina-ku-imu kwan-a
S.PHON: kwana no anaknəm pokən a ʂinakoimo kwana
S.FORM: koana no anaknem poken a sinakoimo koana
S.PHON: k[o|u]ana n[o|u] anaknəm p[o|u]kən a ɕinak[o|u]im[o|u] k[o|u]ana
S.TRANSL: "Then you are not my mother?" said the child.

S.FORM: maniring u anak-ne-m ni-salep-na-imu nu kangkang nu k-angay-ta mang-ali su uvi? siu? kwan-a
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ o anaknəm niʂaləpnaimo no kaŋkaŋ no kaŋajta maŋali ʂo ofiʔ ʂioʔ kwana
S.FORM: maniring o anaknem nisalepnaimo no kangkang no kangayta mangali so ovi sio koana
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ [o|u] anaknəm niʂaləpnaim[o|u] n[o|u] kaŋkaŋ n[o|u] kaŋajta maŋali ʂ[o|u] [o|u]fi ɕi[o|u] k[o|u]ana
S.TRANSL: "The rooster took you when we went to get some potatoes a long time ago."

S.FORM: maniring s-ina-na-m ning kwan-a nuyud-ku-imu a anak-em mangwat-kamu su chinwat kwan-a
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ ʂinanam niŋ kwana nojoɖkoimo a anakəm maŋwatkamo ʂo ʨinwat kwana
S.FORM: maniring sinanam ning koana noyodkoimo a anakem mangoatkamo so cinoat koana
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ ɕinanam niŋ k[o|u]ana n[o|u]j[o|u]ɖk[o|u]im[o|u] a anakəm maŋ[o|u]atkam[o|u] ʂ[o|u] ʨin[o|u]at k[o|u]ana
S.TRANSL: His mother said, "If it's true you are my child, when boiling water is thrown on you
We'll see if you'll be killed."

S.FORM: taktakana-rana u anak-na nu chinwat-em tongwus
S.PHON: taktakanaɻana o anakna no ʨinwatəm toŋwoʂ
S.FORM: taktakanarana o anakna no cinoatem tongoos
S.TRANSL: Boiling water was thrown on her child.

S.FORM: maniring u ina-na-m manuyung a anak-u-imu kwan-a
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ o inanam manojoŋ a anakoimo kwana
S.FORM: maniring o inanam manoyong a anakoimo koana
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ [o|u] inanam man[o|u]j[o|u]ŋ a anak[o|u]im[o|u] k[o|u]ana
S.TRANSL: "You're truly my child!" said his mother.

S.FORM: mai-rana sira lu vaǥay-ta machyura u ina-na
S.PHON: maiɻana ʂiɻa lo faɰajta maʨjoɻa o inana
S.FORM: mairana sira lo vahayta maciora o inana
S.PHON: maiɻana ɕiɻa l[o|u] faɰajta maʨi[o|u]ɻa [o|u] inana
S.TRANSL: and returned to their house accompanied by the mother.

S.FORM: maniring u ama-na-m mang-aep ta-ka-mu su vatu kwan-a
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ o amanam maŋaəp takamo ʂo fato kwana
S.FORM: maniring o amanam mangaep takamo so vato koana
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ [o|u] amanam maŋaəp takam[o|u] ʂ[o|u] fat[o|u] k[o|u]ana
S.TRANSL: His father said, "Let's take some stones

S.FORM: y-atey-ta su vaǥay-ta ta-manginanawa ta-ka-mu di-mai kwan-a
S.PHON: jatəjta ʂo faɰajta tamaŋinanawa takamo ɖimai kwana
S.FORM: yateyta so vahayta tamanginanawa takamo dimai koana
S.PHON: jatəjta ʂ[o|u] faɰajta tamaŋinanawa takam[o|u] ɖimai k[o|u]ana
S.TRANSL: and make the stone walls of our house, but be careful."

S.FORM: ka-pangay-ta su aru dinalulut lu vaǥay-ta
S.PHON: kapaŋajta ʂo aɻo ɖinalolot lo faɰajta
S.FORM: kapangayta so aro dinalolot lo vahayta
S.PHON: kapaŋajta ʂ[o|u] aɻ[o|u] ɖinal[o|u]l[o|u]t l[o|u] faɰajta
S.TRANSL: Then they put many spirit-weapons in their house

S.FORM: mai-rana lu kangkang-em apwapwasena u atey-na lu vaǥay-ta
S.PHON: maiɻana lo kaŋkaŋəm apwapwaʂəna o atəjna lo faɰajta
S.FORM: mairana lo kangkangem apoapoasena o ateyna lo vahayta
S.PHON: maiɻana l[o|u] kaŋkaŋəm ap[o|u]ap[o|u]aʂəna [o|u] atəjna l[o|u] faɰajta
S.TRANSL: They went to the rooster's house and took stones from his house to their house (unctn).

S.FORM: ingunguna u katawtaw-na-m m-angay-rana lu ilaud u kangkang
S.PHON: iŋoŋona o katawtawnam maŋajɻana lo ilaoɖ o kaŋkaŋ
S.FORM: ingongona o katawtawnam mangayrana lo ilaod o kangkang
S.PHON: iŋ[o|u]ŋ[o|u]na [o|u] katawtawnam maŋajɻana l[o|u] ila[o|u]ɖ [o|u] kaŋkaŋ
S.TRANSL: The rooster had gone to a foreign country.
